text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick question for payroll/benefits: whats our authoritative cutoff for 2026 401(k) salary deferrals and catch-up contributions? We need a single date for the handbook and an FAQ entry.

Lina: Are we talking submission cutoff or vendor posting date? Those can differ.

Carlos (Payroll): Submission cutoff is the practical control. Our internal payroll feed must be finalized and uploaded to RetireCo by 2026-12-23 20:00 PT to guarantee posting in 2026. Anything after that risks vendor processing in Jan.

Jules (Benefits): RetireCo confirmed they close the calendar-year import on 12/24 end-of-day, but they cannot promise acceptance of late retro entries. They also charge per-transaction fees for retro fixes.

Sam (People Ops): Ok — propose we put this on the benefits page: "Submit changes by 2026-12-23 20:00 PT to ensure contributions post in 2026. Changes after this may be processed in January and could incur vendor fees." Thoughts?

Carlos (Payroll): Fine from ops. Add a line about timezone (PT) and that payroll reconciliation should finish by 12/23 noon to allow fixes.

Jules (Benefits): Add note about catch-up eligibility: employees who turn 50 on or before 2026-12-31 are eligible for catch-up for the full year. Also: HSA/FSA final deductions depend on whether termination occurred before payroll submission. If someone leaves after cutoff, deductions will likely appear on final pay.

Lina: Can we also mention who to contact for manual retro requests and the likely timeline/fee? People will ask.

Sam (People Ops): Good point. Please confirm contact (Benefits team) and a short line: "Manual retro adjustments may be possible; submit requests to benefits@redwood.com within 30 days. Vendor may charge fees and retro entries are not guaranteed."

Carlos (Payroll): Confirmed. We'll accept requests but note potential fees and processing lag.

HR Bot: Policy reminder created: benefits page update draft due 2026-11-30.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all  can someone drop the final blurb here when it's ready so I can publish? :pray:
